Westfield Skunk Works · SKW-041

A real sofa. Ordered like anything else.

Deployable steel-tube engineering · one 42 × 42 in frame · six configurations

01 — The problem

Furniture is the worst thing e-commerce ever tried to ship.

01 · THE FREIGHT

Big and bulky, and it arrives damaged — large-item delivery is expensive in both directions.

02 · THE RETURNS

Returns run high, and reverse logistics on an oversize item eats the margin.

03 · THE PENALTY

The convenient option arrives flat-packed, so the customer pays for it with an assembly fight.

The category solved delivery by making the customer finish the product.

02 — The idea

Bed in a box. Now sofa in a box.

Compression changed how people buy mattresses. Deployment changes how people buy sofas. Collapse a usable indoor structure into a smaller logistics cube — then open it without tools.

Thesis — make a real sofa as easy to buy as anything else online

COLLAPSED · FRAME + PANELS

03 — The mechanism

Westfield already knows how to make steel fold.

A quad fold — all four sides scissor at once, so the frame closes on both axes into a bundle instead of a flat panel. The chair beside this screen opens exactly like this.

06 — The category

We are aimed at the fastest-growing corner of it.

Fastest material

Within ready-to-assemble furniture, steel is the fastest-growing material.

Fastest category

And sofas are the fastest-growing product category.

The shape of demand

Sectionals and modular sofas are already the largest segment of the sofa market.

Why it is open

Furniture is structurally hard for e-commerce — and that is exactly what this fixes.

Steel · sofas · modular — Instant Indoor sits where all three meet

07 — Why Westfield

Everything this needs, we already own.

Deployable engineering

Steel tube that folds, carries load and ships tight — our core competence, pointed indoors.

Manufacturing

Our own steel-tube supply chain and factory relationships, not rented manufacturing.

Distribution

Existing retail and e-commerce relationships already carry our product.

Counter-seasonal

Indoor furniture fills outdoor's production and sales troughs.

The DTC furniture shakeout proved the demand. It also proved that marketing-first brands can't carry the cost.

08 — The IP position

The design-around is the mechanism.

The FTO review put Burrow's family at the center of the risk — panel clips, latches and cushion-coupler architectures. Instant Indoor doesn't go near them: a steel-tube quad fold is a different machine.
